claim_one_line: THE HIGGS IS NEARLY NULL (P-344; PROVED, no new data contact): R is exactly null (Jacobi) and the censuses' Higgs has h.h = eta^6/4 exactly, so its reality r = |h.h|/|h|^2 falls like e^(-pi Im tau) (0.0058 at Im tau 3); rho(T)'s (j, k) eigenlines (0, 1, +-i) are null and the sections on record are led by them at the cusp (F_6 too: F_6.F_6 = -48 eta^6, reality 0.0019 at 3). With u = 0 the left null vector of u1 [h]_x is conj(h) exactly; with the channel triplet on, each sector's lightest state overlaps conj(h) under S and h under S~ (median 0.999). So under the Standard Model's reading (S~ up, S down) the lightest up and down states are nearly orthogonal: on B1726's census the median |V_ud| is 0.28 (0.105 at Im tau 3-3.5) against 0.995 for equal readings, and per tau it follows r^0.52 (log-correlation 0.996). The hierarchy (Im tau about 3) and an unmixed light generation (|V_ud| 0.974) exclude each other with this Higgs under that reading; a Higgs led by the non-null eigenline e_i, or another reading rule, would be needed. 0 of 19.
